stem: A 5 kg block rests on a smooth incline of 30°, held by a string parallel to the incline. The tension in the string is: (A) 5 N (B) 25 N (C) 10 N (D) 0
Three blocks A (mass m₁), B (m₂), C (m₃) are stacked vertically, A on top of B on top of C on the ground. The force exerted by block C on block B is: (A) m₁g (B) (m₁+m₂)g (C) m₂g (D) (m₁+m₂+m₃)g

A 5 kg block hangs at a junction held by a horizontal string (tension T₁, to a left wall) and a string T₂ going up to the ceiling at 53° to the horizontal. The ratio T₂/T₁ is: (A) 3/5 (B) 3/4 (C) 5/3 (D) 4/3

A 10 kg load hangs from junction C. String CA rises to the ceiling at 60° to the horizontal; string CB is horizontal to a right wall. Find the tensions in AC and BC: (A) 100, 200 (B) 100/√3, 200/√3 (C) 200/√3, 100/√3 (D) 200√3, 100√3
A 1 kg block is held at rest on a smooth 37° incline by a horizontal force F. Find F: (A) 10 N (B) 5 N (C) 7.5 N (D) 2.5 N

A 20 N weight hangs from point O. String T₁ goes up-left to the ceiling at 60° to the horizontal; string T₂ goes down-right to a wall at 60° to the wall; the angle T₁OT₂ = 150°. Find T₁ and T₂: (A) 10 N, 10√3 N (B) 40√3 N, 40 N (C) 20 N, 20√3 N (D) 30√3 N, 30 N
A 5 kg block hangs from a string fixed to the ceiling; the string makes 60° with the ceiling. A horizontal force F holds the block in equilibrium. If F = x/√3 N, find x.

A body of weight 2 kg is suspended as shown in the figure (one string from the ceiling making 30° with the ceiling, one horizontal string T 1 to a wall, and the 2 kg-wt load hanging from the junction). The tension T 1 in the horizontal string (in kg wt) is (A) 2/√3 (B) √3/2 (C) 2√3 (D) 2

Find the tension T 2 in the system shown in figure. [Figure: three blocks hang in series from the ceiling — string T 1 from the ceiling to the 1 kg block, string T 2 from the 1 kg block to the 2 kg block, string T 3 from the 2 kg block to the 3 kg block at the bottom.] (A) 1g N (B) 2g N (C) 5g N (D) 6g N
